design_go_record.sha256_status: INSERTED_BY_SUPERVISOR_DETERMINISTIC_PROVENANCE_PATCH; no compile, fixture, simulation, or scientific execution was performed.

predecessor.relationship: Source adapted in place from an authenticated copy of the accepted study-001 package. No study-001 code is imported or loaded at runtime. No study-001 random tape, block, trajectory or outcome is reused: every key text carries the study-002 identifier.

population.cache_rule: post-mutation M: cache := producing parent's pre-update genotype (valid); post-mutation F: cache invalid; initial caches invalid

updates.measurement_point: after survival, policy mutation and cache transition

target_law.name: HALF
target_law.rule: T_1 = I_1, T_2 = I_2; for t >= 3, T_t = T_(t-2) if R_t = 1 else I_t

policy_probe_rule.INFO: label M and cache valid: c (true cache); otherwise x XOR fresh_mask
policy_probe_rule.NONINFO: label M and cache valid and (t < 3 or R_t = 0): c; label M and cache valid and t >= 3 and R_t = 1: x XOR pi_(block,t)(c XOR x); otherwise x XOR fresh_mask
policy_probe_rule.SHAM: x XOR fresh_mask for every label and cache state; SHAM never reads label or cache when constructing genotypes

candidates.donor_rule: lowest mismatch among families 0-2; tie: lowest unsigned 64-bit donor key; tie: lowest family index

decoy_permutation.shared_by: all 32 parents and all six cells of one (block, update)
decoy_permutation.construction: start [0..31]; for i = 31, ..., 1: j uniform in [0, i] by 64-bit Lemire multiply-high rejection with bound i+1 (accept iff low64(x*(i+1)) >= (2^64-(i+1)) mod (i+1); j = high64(x*(i+1))); retry r = 0, 1, ... on rejection; swap perm[i], perm[j]
decoy_permutation.mapping: source bit s of the displacement maps to destination bit perm[s]
decoy_permutation.preserves: popcount(c XOR x) pathwise; pairwise overlaps of displacement masks under one common coordinate relabeling
decoy_permutation.does_not_preserve: a common cached endpoint among siblings; every cross-genotype geometric relation
decoy_permutation.extreme_weights_retained: displacement weight 0 or 32 cannot be scrambled; these decoy applications retain direction and are counted (decoy_w0, decoy_w32) and reported

selection.method: sequential Plackett-Luce without replacement over unselected candidates in candidate-index order; Z uniform in [0,W) by Lemire multiply-high rejection: threshold = (2^64 - W) mod W, reject when low64(x*W) < threshold, else Z = high64(x*W); select first remaining candidate whose cumulative weight > Z; survivor slot = draw order

design.cell_index_formula: 2*arm + start with INFO=0, NONINFO=1, SHAM=2; ALL_F=0, ALL_M=1

rng.key_derivation: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 key text; key word 0 = digest bytes 0..3 little-endian; key word 1 = digest bytes 4..7 little-endian

DECOY_PERMUTATION.extraction: x = uint64(word0) | (uint64(word1) << 32); words 2-3 unused; j = high64(x*(step+1)) unless rejected by Lemire, then retry+1

rng.shared_across_cells: counters omit arm, start, label, cache and recurrence; identical counters across the six paired cells are intentional sharing

identities.N1: SHAM genotype, target, mismatch, survival-retry and survivor-index trajectories are bit-identical between ALL_F and ALL_M after every update
identities.N2: SHAM labels are exact slotwise complements between ALL_F and ALL_M after every update
identities.C1: for each start, INFO and NONINFO are bit-identical in every update and post-update state through the update before the first update at which some decoy probe differs from the true cache; that first update must be recurrent, and its pre-update diagnostics must agree
identities.query_count: exactly 128 objective queries in every path-update

inference.method: two-sided Hoeffding with Bonferroni; h = R * sqrt(ln(2/alpha_each) / (2n)); no empirical variance, normal approximation, pilot or within-path independence

decision_rules_in_order.label: INVALID
decision_rules_in_order.condition: any deterministic identity (N1, N2, C1), coordinate, query-count, saved-output or independent-audit failure; post-production INVALID is terminal

decision_rules_in_order.label: START-DEPENDENT; PRIMARY UNRESOLVED
decision_rules_in_order.condition: interval for D_INFO or D_NONINFO not wholly inside the open interval (-delta, +delta)

decision_rules_in_order.label: MEANINGFUL POSITIVE DIRECTIONAL-INFORMATION EFFECT RELATIVE TO NONINFO
MEANINGFUL ADVERSE DIRECTIONAL-INFORMATION EFFECT RELATIVE TO NONINFO
BOUNDED BELOW THE POSITIVE ONE-BIT SCALE
decision_rules_in_order.condition: upper(Delta_P) <= delta; additionally state whether the interval is wholly inside (-delta, +delta)

secondary_classification_rules_in_order.label: MEANINGFUL POSITIVE AT THE ONE-BIT SCALE
MEANINGFUL ADVERSE AT THE ONE-BIT SCALE
BOUNDED BELOW THE POSITIVE ONE-BIT SCALE

interpretive_branches.statement: Directional cache information produces a one-bit benefit relative to both the matched decoy and SHAM in this fixed model.

interpretive_branches.when: primary rule 3 and not lower(B_INFO) > delta
interpretive_branches.statement: Directional information offsets some displacement cost relative to NONINFO; no one-bit absolute benefit over no-memory use is demonstrated.

interpretive_branches.when: primary rule 4 or 5 and lower(E_INFO) > delta
interpretive_branches.statement: Directional information selects for policy use without converting into one-bit population performance, sharpening the selection-performance separation.

interpretive_branches.when: primary rule 4 or 5 and not lower(E_INFO) > delta
interpretive_branches.statement: The fixed information intervention does not explain the accepted enrichment; close this conversion route.
No interpretive branch applies; the primary question is unresolved and the secondary families are reported without changing it.

claim_limits: Delta_P is the total population-accuracy effect of directional cache information beyond the parent and matched displacement length, mediated through evolved policy use.
It is not a per-use value-of-information estimate, does not separate retention from retrieval, and does not demonstrate spontaneous memory origin.
The fixed shared permutation does not preserve every cross-genotype relation; displacement weights 0 and 32 cannot be scrambled and retain direction.
A null, bounded or adverse outcome is reportable and must not trigger a numerical extension.

The result is limited to one supplied cache, one HALF law, one fixed displacement cost and one parent-distance-matched directional-scramble control; no generalization to other lags, costs, models or biology.

output.shard_rule: shard = floor(block / 1300); output bytes are independent of thread count

neutral_expectations.note: SHAM start-averaged M frequency is exactly 1/2 in every block by N2; the closed form justifies the window in expectation only
